entity.title: MonitorAction
entity.description: A GitHub Action that monitors target repositories for synchronization drift.

rules.body: IS a GitHub Action that monitors target repositories for synchronization drift.
MUST support scheduled execution via cron.
MUST read the DeploymentState to determine expected template versions per repository.
MUST verify actual file content in target repositories against expected versions using Blake3 hash comparison.
MUST create a GitHub issue in the central repository for each out-of-sync target repository.
MUST link created issues to existing SyncPullRequests when applicable.
MUST NOT create duplicate issues for the same drift.
MUST auto-close drift issues when the drift is resolved (configurable via `auto-close`).
Each drift issue MUST include: repository name, template identifier, expected version, actual version (or hash), link to related PR, and time since drift was first detected.
HAS an input `config-path` (string, default: "steerspec-sync.yml") to specify an alternate config file path.

HAS an input `target-filter` (string, optional) to limit monitoring to repositories whose `owner/repo` matches any of a comma-separated list of glob patterns, with the same semantics as the sync action; a malformed pattern fails the run.
HAS an output `repos-in-sync` (integer) counting repositories with current versions.
HAS an output `repos-drifted` (integer) counting repositories with detected drift.
HAS an output `issues-created` (integer) counting new issues created.
HAS an output `issues-closed` (integer) counting drift issues auto-closed.
HAS an output `summary` (JSON string) containing a detailed monitoring report.
MUST update the existing open issue for the same repo/template combination while its drift is still detected.

notes.content: Hash comparison is preferred over version string comparison because it detects manual modifications to managed files that wouldn't change the version metadata.
